title: Lack of confidentiality during registration
description: Homeowner's personal information (name, contact details, account credentials) could be exposed during the registration process on the Home Hub.
assumptions: Registration data is transmitted over potentially unencrypted channels or stored without adequate encryption.

title: Information leakage of device enrollment data
description: Personal data about the homeowner's enrolled cameras and sensors could be leaked to unauthorized parties during the enrollment process.
assumptions: Device configuration and location data may be transmitted without proper access controls.

title: Data integrity of registration information
description: Registration data submitted by the homeowner could be tampered with or altered during transmission to the Home Hub.
assumptions: Data in transit may not be protected with integrity mechanisms.

title: Unauthorized access to registration process
description: The Home Hub could be accessed by unauthorized parties during the registration process, potentially compromising the homeowner's account.
assumptions: Authentication and authorization controls may be insufficient.

title: Access Code Leakage During Entry
description: Guest may inadvertently leak the temporary access code through visible screen display, audible speech, or improper logging during the entry process at the Home Hub.

title: Unauthorized Access via Compromised Code
description: Weak or predictable temporary access codes may be guessed or intercepted, allowing unauthorized individuals to unlock the front door.

title: System Reveals Guest Presence
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently reveal the guest's presence or activities through door unlocking patterns, access logs, or system responses that could be observed by others.

title: Unintended Door Access
description: The temporary access code may be reused or misused, causing the door to unlock for unintended individuals or at unintended times.

title: Data Loss During Storage
description: Motion/door/sensor events written to the local event log may be lost due to storage corruption, power failure, or hardware failure, resulting in incomplete event records.
assumptions: Local event log storage is not backed up or has no redundancy

title: Unauthorized Access to Event Log
description: An unauthorized actor may gain access to the local event log and read or modify motion/door/sensor events without proper authorization.
assumptions: Local event log is accessible to any actor on the network or device

title: Unauthorized Disclosure of Event Data
description: Motion/door/sensor events stored in the local event log may be disclosed to unauthorized parties through improper access controls or data leakage.
assumptions: Event log is not properly secured or encrypted

title: Unintended Data Flow to Event Log
description: Data may be written to the local event log in unintended formats or with unintended content, potentially including sensitive information not intended for storage.
assumptions: Home Hub may write additional data beyond motion/door/sensor events

title: Data Loss During Upload
description: Camera clips may be lost during the upload process from Home Hub to Cloud Video Storage due to network failures, server crashes, or transmission errors.

title: Unauthorized Data Disclosure During Upload
description: Camera clips may be disclosed to unauthorized parties during the upload process due to insecure transmission, interception, or misconfiguration.

title: Data Unavailability During Upload
description: Camera clips may become unavailable during the upload process due to network outages, service disruptions, or system failures.

title: Unauthorized Access to Stored Camera Clips
description: Camera clips stored in Cloud Video Storage may be accessed by unauthorized parties due to insufficient access controls or security vulnerabilities.

title: Unauthorized Deletion of Camera Clips
description: Camera clips stored in Cloud Video Storage may be deleted by unauthorized parties due to insufficient access controls or security vulnerabilities.

title: Motion notification may disclose sensitive occupancy information
description: The motion-detected notification sent to the homeowner may inadvertently reveal sensitive information about the homeowner's home occupancy patterns, presence of family members, or when the home is empty, potentially compromising privacy.
assumptions: The notification contains motion detection data that could be interpreted as occupancy information.

title: Notification may contain unnecessary or excessive information
description: The motion-detected notification may include more information than necessary for the intended purpose, potentially exposing data that exceeds the homeowner's privacy expectations.
assumptions: The notification includes motion data that may be more detailed than required for simple presence notification.

title: Homeowner may lack control over notification timing and content
description: The homeowner may not have adequate control over when notifications are sent or what information is included, potentially leading to unexpected or unwanted privacy exposures.
assumptions: Notification settings may not be fully customizable or may be overridden by system logic.

title: Unauthorized disclosure of aggregated device-usage analytics to external vendor
description: Mobile app backend shares aggregated device-usage analytics with cloud analytics vendor, potentially exposing user behavior patterns that could be re-identified or misused by the vendor beyond intended purposes.
assumptions: Aggregated data may still contain identifiable patterns or be re-identifiable through correlation with other data sources.

title: Unauthorized access to analytics data by external vendor
description: Cloud analytics vendor may access the shared device-usage analytics data beyond authorized purposes or without proper authorization controls.
assumptions: Vendor may have access to data through API or data transfer mechanisms without adequate access controls.

title: Potential non-compliance with privacy regulations
description: Sharing device-usage analytics with external vendor may violate privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) if proper consent, data minimization, or purpose limitation is not ensured.
assumptions: Data sharing may not have explicit user consent or may exceed original purpose of data collection.

title: Violation of storage limitation principle
description: Video clips stored in cloud storage may be retained longer than necessary for the intended purpose, violating data minimization and storage limitation principles.
assumptions: Assumes video retention policy exceeds minimum required retention period for playback functionality.
uncertainty_note: Uncertainty: Retention policies may vary by jurisdiction and use case; this is a general assessment based on typical cloud storage practices.

title: Inadequate data protection during storage
description: Video data in cloud storage may not be adequately protected against unauthorized access, leading to potential data exposure during storage before retrieval.
assumptions: Assumes standard cloud storage security controls may not be sufficient for sensitive video content.
uncertainty_note: Uncertainty: Specific encryption and access control measures depend on cloud provider configuration, which is not fully specified.

title: Unauthorized access during video retrieval
description: Mobile app backend may retrieve video clips for unauthorized users or without proper authentication, leading to unintended data exposure.
assumptions: Assumes authentication and authorization controls may be bypassed or misconfigured during video retrieval process.
uncertainty_note: Uncertainty: Access control implementation depends on specific app security architecture and authentication mechanisms.

title: Data loss during video retrieval
description: Video clips may be lost or corrupted during the retrieval process from cloud storage to mobile app backend, affecting data availability and integrity.
assumptions: Assumes network or system failures could occur during data transfer between storage and processing components.
uncertainty_note: Uncertainty: Data loss likelihood depends on network reliability, storage system redundancy, and error handling mechanisms.
